boundary: Information Quality would be added only if the action altered or corrupted information so that it became inaccurate or misleading, for example by breaking the index-to-recording match while keeping the files, rather than destroying the data outright.
factor: a second label for information loss that is the same harm as destroying a data asset
note: The assessor correctly established that the deletion irrecoverably destroys the sole copy of archival recordings, but added an information label for the same deletion; destruction does not make information inaccurate, so the asset label alone fits.
